sn45.160:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā ||
sn45.160:1.2: atha mahā janakāyo āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakam ādāya
sn45.160:1.3: Mayam imaṃ Gaṅgaṃ nadim pacchāninnaṃ karissāma pacchāpoṇam pacchāpabbhāranti || ||
sn45.160:1.5: api nu so mahājanakāyo Gaṅgaṃ nadim pacchāninnaṃ kāreyya pacchāpoṇam pacchāpabbhāran ti || ||
sn45.160:1.8: Gaṅgā bhante nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbharā ||
sn45.160:1.9: sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātum pacchāpoṇam pacchāpabbhāraṃ ||
sn45.160:1.10: yāvadeva pana so mahā janakāyo kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā ti || || 3.
sn45.160:1.11: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhum ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāventam ariyam a- maggam bahulīkarontam rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñāti vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhum pavāreyyuṃ || ||
sn45.160:1.12: Ehambho purisa kiṃ te ime kāsāvā anudahanti
sn45.160:1.14: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassa puññāni ca karohī ti || ||
sn45.160:1.15: So vata bhikkhave bhikkhu a- amaggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto sikkham paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissati || netam ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn45.160:1.17: Yañhitam bhikkhave cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ vivekaninnaṃ vivekapoṇam vivekapabbhāram taṃ vata hīnāyāvattissatī ti netam ṭhānam vijjati || ||
sn45.160:1.18: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.160:1.19: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāganirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || ||
sn45.160:1.20: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkarotī ti || ||
sn45.160:1.21: Yad api balakaraṇīyaṃ tad api vitthāretabbaṃ || ||
